value: PAYDAY 2 VO mods — the single source of truth
2026-11-28 by tools/build_vo_master.py (make -sC tools/pd2-las voices_master). Do not hand-edit this workbook or the CSVs beside it; change the tool or the sources and rebuild.

One row per voice-line id from every source the repository holds — the community sheets (imported in full), Hila's 885-line bank, the shipped .stream pack, the Sydney and Bodhi documents, the event-name callout table — joined on the id, with machine transcripts of every audio file the reference packs carry. It replaces docs/pd2-voice-mod-install.md, docs/pd2-voice-stream-tables.md and docs/tokoyami-hila-voice-mod-analysis.md, which were deleted on 2026-11-28. The decisions live on in docs/pd2-las/DECISIONS.md.
THE ID IS THE HANDLE. Wwise strips every name; a line is a file soundbanks/streamed/<bank>/<id>.stream. Line text is evidence, never an override.

INSTALL ONLY ONE shared-bank .stream pack — today that is Miranda_Lawson_VO_over_Hila_Stream (see packs tab); the Geralt/Arivus shared-bank stream packs were retired and deleted 2026-11-28 (D89). Geralt_VO_over_Rust uses BeardLib <Sounds> event redirects scoped to prefix="rb16" with a companion Lua lifecycle fix (D97), so it coexists cleanly alongside Miranda_Lawson_VO_over_Hila_Stream.
Uncovered slots stay VANILLA rather than a weak take. 27 ids are Wwise Vorbis (no ADPCM pack can write them) and 17 slots (162 ids) scored below the semantic-fit floor — those play as vanilla Hila.
Community-sheet wording is community-sourced: wrong, stale and duplicated rows exist; needs_review marks them. Sydney and Bodhi rows are document-sourced, pdf-only ids are unverified.

MACHINE TRANSCRIPTS ARE UNVERIFIED DRAFTS. Whisper's model hosts are unreachable from this environment, so every transcript column here is pocketsphinx output (see transcripts tab, engine column) — a reading aid to flag for review, never final wording. Miranda's 866 source oggs are the exception: those carry whisper transcripts + hand corrections (miranda_lawson/miranda_transcripts_corrected.csv, imported as the miranda_transcripts tab).

The community REGULAR_VOX export is NOT the bank the packs write: 0 of the 885 pack-bank ids appear in it, while the community ROBBERS_MISSION_GEN export DOES match the packs (196/202 tokoyami, 213/220 marine). Treat every id→line pair for the pack bank as UNVERIFIED by that sheet; only Hila's own list (hila_regular_vox.csv) and the slot table name those ids' text. See finding F1.
char_rust: the 1,046 ids are measured, the lines are not. The re-key (D76) stays blocked until a game extraction names them. Do not fill slots for them.
slot → bank → id tables the packs are built from live in voice_lines_vox/targets/ (pinned to the zips by tests/test_stream_tables.py); this workbook folds them into the regular_vox and slots tabs.

ID-SPACE MISMATCH (measured 2026-11-27): 0 of 885 pack-bank ids are in the community regular_vox export (20,404 rows, 20,403 ids). The robbers_mission_gen export matches the packs (196/202 and 213/220) — so the ids are real, the regular_vox tab simply covers a different bank than the one the packs write. The 20,404-row table is kept here because it is the only id→line evidence for ITS bank; it cannot verify the pack bank.
The reference pack writes 887 regular_vox files: the 885 ids in Hila's list plus 124616049 and 134711817, which appear in NO tracked table (noted, unused).

Marine VO for Rust carries 1 id that also sits in the community robbers_mission_gen export; char_rust and regular_vox (community) share 0. Rust's own bank question (D71) stays open; the pack writes the shared bank.

Miranda pack heard in game and works (2026-11-25, user report). Geralt and Arivus packs have NOT been heard. Evidence vs assumption: the spreadsheet marks every row measured vs derived; nothing here is in-game-verified beyond the Hila pack.

The Marine reference pack also carries 55 Wwise Vorbis files in char_rust (fmt tag 0xFFFF), on top of Tokoyami’s 27 — none of them decodable with the ADPCM codec. Any dedicated-bank pack must filter Vorbis out the same way (measurement, 2026-11-28).
shared-bank lines, both id spaces (community export; hila-dlc-bank), one row per id; pack coverage, Vorbis/removed markers, machine transcript where audio exists
